events.text: oh no, I think my order is going to my old address. I just moved last week and I only just noticed. Can you help me?

I'm sorry about that, and I'll help. First I need to verify your identity. Please send me your full name and either the email address or the phone number on your account. If you have the order ID, send that too.
Sure, my full name is Hannah Schultz, and the email on my account is hschultz@post.example. The order number is 5107.

Thank you, Hannah. You're verified. I'm sorry, but I can't change the address on order 5107. It has already been picked up by the courier and is on its way, and we can only change an address while an order is still being prepared. For the same reason, I can't cancel it.

Here is what you can do:
- Contact the restaurant or the courier through the app if it's available to you. They may be able to help directly.
- Watch for the delivery. If it goes to the old address, you could ask whoever lives there now to hold it for you.
- If the order doesn't reach you or arrives wrong, contact us within 48 hours of delivery. We can then review it under our missing-item policy.

I can also have a human specialist follow up with you within 24 hours, if you'd like that. Would you like me to do that?

Oh no, that's a shame. I'm not sure I can get to the courier through the app, and I don't want to bother whoever lives at Ridge Rd now. Can you at least tell me if a refund is possible? I'd rather cancel than have the food go to the wrong place.

I understand, Hannah. Unfortunately, a refund isn't possible right now. Order 5107 has been picked up, and our policy doesn't allow cancelling or refunding an order at that stage. We also can't give a refund just because the address was out of date.

What I can do:
- **If the food never arrives, or arrives with items missing or wrong,** contact us within 48 hours of delivery. We can then refund the affected items to your card or give account credit of the item price plus 20%, whichever you prefer.
- **If it arrives more than 15 minutes after the promised time of 7:40 PM,** you'd be eligible for account credit under our late-delivery policy.
- **Specialist follow-up:** I can pass your case to a human specialist, who will contact you within 24 hours.

Would you like me to escalate it to a specialist, or is there anything else I can help with?

Okay, I understand. I don't want to keep you too long, and I know it's not really your fault, but I'd rather not have the food go to the wrong place. I think I'll just accept it and see what happens. Thank you for trying to help.
